epics.title: Standalone Responsive Knowledge Base & Fast Search Tool
epics.jtbd: When an educational resident, researcher, or faculty member accesses the CRIE knowledge base on desktop or mobile, I want a fast, thoughtful, self-contained search and document exploration interface without third-party integration friction, so that I can immediately find and inspect clinical, academic, and normative resources in seconds.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Mockup visual regression delta <= 0.1% and layout fidelity score >= 99%
epics.tocConstraintRef: UI presentation rendering and design layout fidelity
requirements: R1: Implement pixel-perfect frontend UI updates according to approved design mockup design/approved/20261118031025-mockup/mockup.html, patching existing templates and styles while maintaining full accessibility and responsive layouts across viewports.

slices.title: Implement pixel-perfect UI updates from approved design mockup
slices.jtbd: When implementing the approved design mockup updates for this epic, I want to update existing frontend templates and stylesheets to match design/approved/20261118031025-mockup/mockup.html, so that the knowledge base interface achieves pixel-perfect visual fidelity and responsive presentation without regressions.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the approved design mockup at design/approved/20261118031025-mockup/mockup.html
When updating the existing frontend templates and stylesheets
Then all UI components, typography, color tokens, and layout spacing match the approved design mockup with visual fidelity
Given mobile, tablet, and desktop viewports
When rendering the updated UI across 375px, 768px, and 1280px widths
Then the layout adapts without horizontal overflow or visual clipping and maintains WCAG accessibility standards
Given the integrated frontend test suite
When running frontend verification tests
Then all UI assertions pass without regressions to existing search and document view interactions
